name: Hellapagos

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when the survivors board the raft, the hurricane forces departure, or everyone dies

categories.label: Players aboard the raft at the end
categories.labelVi: Số người lên bè khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Surviving castaways who left the island (0 if the game ended in total failure or the hurricane hit without a valid departure)

categories.label: Escaped on the raft (win)
categories.hint: Tick if this player was aboard when the raft left. Tournament (cooperative) points = number of players aboard

winCondition: All players aboard the raft when it leaves win together. The raft leaves at the end of a round when raft cards built >= survivors and at least 1 water and 1 food per survivor remain after rations; it must leave when the Hurricane weather card is revealed (votes and sacrifices are allowed to meet the conditions, otherwise everyone loses). If everyone dies of thirst or hunger, all lose.

endCondition.description: Players are eliminated by votes when water or food runs short; game ends on raft departure, hurricane, or total failure

notes: family: social-survival-objective. No points in a single game. Optional tournament mode: cooperative = each player aboard scores as many points as players aboard, highest total after N games wins (modelled by boarded); solitary-castaway scoring (starting player count minus extra survivors plus one, per survivor) is not modelled. Voice of the Dead variant lets eliminated players keep voting.
